headlines.title_en: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind

script: 今天是二零二六年十一月二十八日，歡迎收聽國際新聞。首先關注俄烏戰爭。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基接受英國廣播公司專訪時，對美國表達不滿，認為美方在和平談判中對俄羅斯施壓不夠。他形容川普與普丁之間的友誼很奇怪，並表示不應該把普丁當成朋友看待。接著來看歐洲。西班牙將在週日舉行大選，總理桑切斯與主要對手在選前進行最後造勢。桑切斯希望打破民調劣勢，而對手則指控他沒有說實話，甚至背叛國家。高房價也是年輕選民最關心的議題之一，有年輕情侶表示，因為租金太高，連住在一起都很困難。在大洋洲，紐西蘭選舉結果出爐，由國家黨領導的右派執政聯盟，距離國會過半門檻差了一席，無法單獨組成多數政府。公共衛生方面，烏干達啟動非洲首例信使核糖核酸伊波拉疫苗試驗，鎖定較少見的本迪布焦病毒株，也就是目前鄰國剛果民主共和國疫情背後的病毒株。最後來看南亞。遭到推翻的孟加拉前總理哈西娜計畫在十二月返國，讓孟加拉局勢再度緊繃，也加深了孟加拉與印度之間的緊張關係，外界擔心可能引發新一波動盪。以上是今天的國際新聞，感謝您的收聽。

script: It's November 28, 2026, and this is International News. Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky told the BBC he is frustrated with the United States, saying Washington is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks. He called the friendship between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin strange, and said Putin should not be treated as a friend. In Spain, Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and his rivals held final rallies ahead of Sunday's election. Sánchez hopes to defy the polls, while his main opponents accuse him of not telling the truth and of betrayal. Housing costs remain a major concern for young voters. In New Zealand, the right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen one seat short of the parliamentary majority needed to govern. Uganda has begun an mRNA Ebola vaccine trial, the first of its kind in Africa. It targets the less common Bundibugyo strain behind the outbreak in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. And in South Asia, ousted Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home in December. The move is deepening tensions between Dhaka and Delhi and risks fresh unrest. That's International News for today.
